description: A general JWS whose first signature has b64 false (listed in crit) and whose second has no b64 (true); each MAC correct, the payload "test" is canonical base64url that re-encodes to itself, so the MAC (Python hmac, A.1 key) is correct whether b64 is read as false or true: b64 must be the same for every signature (ADR 0026 §2 step 4, §3)
